chunks: Who will inherit Paradise, and live in it for ever.
ai.seo_question: Who inherits Paradise and lives there eternally according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, Al-Firdaws is often identified as the highest chamber of Paradise, directly beneath the Throne of God, reserved for the Prophets, Truthful, Martyrs, and Righteous. This verse serves as the culmination of the description of the Muttaqin (God-fearing) in Surah Al-Mu'minun, highlighting that eternal residence is not merely a reward but a state of being aligned with divine proximity.
